+package proxy
+
+import (
+	"archive/zip"
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"errors"
+	"io"
+	"mime"
+	"mime/multipart"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"strings"
+
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/dbg"
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/dependencyfirewall/policy"
+)
+
+// NuGetMatcher recognizes NuGet v3 flatcontainer artifact downloads
+// (".../{id}/{version}/{id}.{version}.nupkg") and pushes: a multipart PUT
+// carrying a .nupkg or .snupkg. Each server advertises its own push URL in
+// its service index, so pushes are recognized by body rather than by path. A
+// .nupkg download outside the flatcontainer shape, such as a nuget.org v2 CDN
+// URL, fails closed.
+//
+// Download coordinates carry the id and version lowercased, as the
+// flatcontainer path spells them; push coordinates keep the casing in the
+// package's nuspec.
+type NuGetMatcher struct {
+	limits peekLimits
+}
+
+const nupkgSuffix = ".nupkg"
+
+// maxNuspecSize bounds the decompressed .nuspec read from a pushed package.
+// Manifests are a few KiB; the cap stops a small zip from expanding into a
+// large buffer in the proxy.
+const maxNuspecSize = 1 << 20
+
+func (m NuGetMatcher) Match(req *http.Request) Match {
+	if req == nil {
+		return Match{}
+	}
+	if req.Method == http.MethodPut {
+		return nugetUpload(req, m.limits.orDefault())
+	}
+	// req.URL.Path is already percent-decoded once by Go's parser. Decoding
+	// again would let a double-encoded request present the matcher a different
+	// path than the upstream NuGet server sees, and because an unmatched
+	// request bypasses the firewall that is a policy-bypass vector. Match
+	// against the once-decoded path the origin actually receives.
+	name, version, result := nugetFlatcontainer(req.URL.Path)
+	switch result {
+	case nugetNotDownload:
+		return Match{}
+	case nugetUnparseable:
+		return unparseableMatch("nuget", policy.Download, "unparseable nuget download URL")
+	}
+	return Match{
+		Matched:    true,
+		Pass:       true,
+		Coordinate: policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: name, Version: version},
+		Operation:  policy.Download,
+	}
+}
+
+// nugetFlatcontainerResult classifies a request path relative to the NuGet
+// flatcontainer download shape: not a .nupkg download at all, a .nupkg
+// download whose coordinate could not be parsed (fail closed), or a parsed
+// coordinate.
+type nugetFlatcontainerResult int
+
+const (
+	nugetNotDownload nugetFlatcontainerResult = iota
+	nugetUnparseable
+	nugetParsed
+)
+
+// nugetFlatcontainer parses ".../{id}/{version}/{id}.{version}.nupkg" and
+// returns the id and version. It anchors on the trailing "<id>.<version>.nupkg"
+// filename matching the two path segments that precede it.
+func nugetFlatcontainer(path string) (string, string, nugetFlatcontainerResult) {
+	trimmed := strings.Trim(path, "/")
+	// The ".nupkg" suffix is the in-scope signal; anything else is not a
+	// NuGet artifact download and passes through untouched.
+	if !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), nupkgSuffix) {
+		return "", "", nugetNotDownload
+	}
+	// A ".nupkg" request whose flatcontainer structure or filename does not
+	// yield a coordinate is recognized-but-unparseable: fail closed rather
+	// than forwarding an in-scope download uninspected.
+	parts := strings.Split(trimmed, "/")
+	if len(parts) < 3 {
+		return "", "", nugetUnparseable
+	}
+	id := parts[len(parts)-3]
+	version := parts[len(parts)-2]
+	file := parts[len(parts)-1]
+	if id == "" || version == "" {
+		return "", "", nugetUnparseable
+	}
+	if !strings.EqualFold(file, id+"."+version+nupkgSuffix) {
+		return "", "", nugetUnparseable
+	}
+	return id, version, nugetParsed
+}
+
+func nugetUpload(req *http.Request, limits peekLimits) Match {
+	if req.Body == nil {
+		return Match{}
+	}
+	mediaType, params, err := mime.ParseMediaType(req.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
+	if err != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(mediaType, "multipart/") {
+		return Match{}
+	}
+	peeked := peekUploadBody(req.Body, limits)
+	req.Body = peeked.body
+	if peeked.overLimit {
+		return Match{
+			Matched:    true,
+			Operation:  policy.Upload,
+			Coordinate: policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget"},
+			Reason:     "upload body too large to inspect for dependency firewall policy",
+		}
+	}
+	// The zip central directory sits at the end of the package, past the
+	// in-memory window for a large push, so read the whole spilled body.
+	src := io.Reader(bytes.NewReader(peeked.data))
+	if peeked.spilled != nil {
+		src = peeked.spilled
+	}
+	id, version, found, err := nugetPackageFromMultipart(src, params["boundary"], limits.inMemory)
+	if err != nil {
+		return unparseableMatch("nuget", policy.Upload, "unparseable publish metadata")
+	}
+	// Every PUT in the session reaches this matcher; a multipart upload with
+	// no package in it, such as a test report, is not a push.
+	if !found {
+		return Match{}
+	}
+	return Match{
+		Matched:    true,
+		Pass:       true,
+		Coordinate: policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: id, Version: version},
+		Operation:  policy.Upload,
+	}
+}
+
+var errNuGetPackage = errors.New("unparseable nuget package")
+
+// nugetPackageFromMultipart finds the package among the parts of a push body
+// and reads its coordinate. found is false when no part is a zip archive.
+func nugetPackageFromMultipart(body io.Reader, boundary string, inMemory int64) (string, string, bool, error) {
+	if boundary == "" {
+		return "", "", false, errNuGetPackage
+	}
+	var id, version string
+	found := false
+	mr := multipart.NewReader(body, boundary)
+	for {
+		part, err := mr.NextPart()
+		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
+			return id, version, found, nil
+		}
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", "", false, err
+		}
+		pkg, size, cleanup, err := spoolPart(part, inMemory)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", "", false, err
+		}
+		partID, partVersion, isPackage, err := nugetPackageCoordinate(pkg, size)
+		cleanup()
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", "", false, err
+		}
+		if !isPackage {
+			continue
+		}
+		// One push carries one package; with two, the one checked need not
+		// be the one the server stores.
+		if found {
+			return "", "", false, errNuGetPackage
+		}
+		id, version, found = partID, partVersion, true
+	}
+}
+
+// spoolPart buffers a multipart part for the random access archive/zip needs:
+// in memory up to inMemory bytes, otherwise in a temp file that cleanup
+// removes.
+func spoolPart(part io.Reader, inMemory int64) (io.ReaderAt, int64, func(), error) {
+	mem, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(part, inMemory+1))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, 0, nil, err
+	}
+	if int64(len(mem)) <= inMemory {
+		return bytes.NewReader(mem), int64(len(mem)), func() {}, nil
+	}
+	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "glab-df-nupkg-*")
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, 0, nil, err
+	}
+	cleanup := func() {
+		_ = f.Close()
+		if err := os.Remove(f.Name()); err != nil {
+			dbg.Debugf("dependency firewall: failed to remove nuget spool file %s: %v", f.Name(), err)
+		}
+	}
+	if _, err := f.Write(mem); err != nil {
+		cleanup()
+		return nil, 0, nil, err
+	}
+	n, err := io.Copy(f, part)
+	if err != nil {
+		cleanup()
+		return nil, 0, nil, err
+	}
+	return f, int64(len(mem)) + n, cleanup, nil
+}
+
+var zipLocalHeader = []byte("PK\x03\x04")
+
+// nugetPackageCoordinate reads the coordinate of the package in r. isPackage
+// is false when r is not a zip archive at all.
+func nugetPackageCoordinate(r io.ReaderAt, size int64) (string, string, bool, error) {
+	zr, err := zip.NewReader(r, size)
+	if err != nil {
+		// A part that starts like a zip but does not open is a corrupt
+		// package, not unrelated traffic.
+		head := make([]byte, len(zipLocalHeader))
+		if _, readErr := r.ReadAt(head, 0); readErr == nil && bytes.Equal(head, zipLocalHeader) {
+			return "", "", true, errNuGetPackage
+		}
+		return "", "", false, nil
+	}
+	id, version, err := nuspecCoordinate(zr)
+	return id, version, true, err
+}
+
+// nuspecCoordinate reads <id> and <version> from the package manifest the way
+// NuGet resolves it: the single .nuspec at the archive root (NuGet.Client
+// PackageHelper.IsManifest), and the one id and version in its metadata.
+func nuspecCoordinate(zr *zip.Reader) (string, string, error) {
+	var manifest *zip.File
+	for _, f := range zr.File {
+		if strings.ContainsAny(f.Name, `/\`) || !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(f.Name), ".nuspec") {
+			continue
+		}
+		if manifest != nil {
+			return "", "", errNuGetPackage
+		}
+		manifest = f
+	}
+	if manifest == nil {
+		return "", "", errNuGetPackage
+	}
+	rc, err := manifest.Open()
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(rc, maxNuspecSize+1))
+	if err := errors.Join(err, rc.Close()); err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+	if len(raw) > maxNuspecSize {
+		return "", "", errNuGetPackage
+	}
+	var doc struct {
+		Metadata []struct {
+			ID      []string `xml:"id"`
+			Version []string `xml:"version"`
+		} `xml:"metadata"`
+	}
+	if err := xml.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
+		return "", "", err
+	}
+	// NuGet reads the first id and version where encoding/xml keeps the last,
+	// so a repeated element could name a coordinate NuGet never uses.
+	if len(doc.Metadata) != 1 || len(doc.Metadata[0].ID) != 1 || len(doc.Metadata[0].Version) != 1 {
+		return "", "", errNuGetPackage
+	}
+	id, version := doc.Metadata[0].ID[0], doc.Metadata[0].Version[0]
+	if id == "" || version == "" {
+		return "", "", errNuGetPackage
+	}
+	return id, version, nil
+}

+//go:build !integration
+
+package proxy
+
+import (
+	"archive/zip"
+	"bytes"
+	"io"
+	"mime/multipart"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/dependencyfirewall/policy"
+)
+
+func nugetReq(path string) *http.Request {
+	return httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer"+path, http.NoBody)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetMatchDownload(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(nugetReq("/newtonsoft.json/13.0.1/newtonsoft.json.13.0.1.nupkg"))
+	assert.True(t, m.Matched)
+	assert.True(t, m.Pass)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: "newtonsoft.json", Version: "13.0.1"}, m.Coordinate)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Download, m.Operation)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetMetadataIsNoMatch(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(nugetReq("/newtonsoft.json/index.json"))
+	assert.False(t, m.Matched)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetDoesNotDoubleDecodePath(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// req.URL.Path is already decoded once by Go's parser. The matcher must
+	// evaluate that once-decoded path and not decode it a second time. Simulate
+	// a parser output where the file segment still contains a literal "%2e":
+	// upstream sees "...newtonsoft.json.13.0.1%2enupkg" (not a ".nupkg"), so it
+	// must not match. A second PathUnescape would turn "%2enupkg" into ".nupkg"
+	// and wrongly match.
+	req := nugetReq("/newtonsoft.json/13.0.1/newtonsoft.json.13.0.1.nupkg")
+	req.URL.Path = "/newtonsoft.json/13.0.1/newtonsoft.json.13.0.1%2enupkg"
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.False(t, m.Matched, "matcher must not perform a second percent-decode of req.URL.Path")
+}
+
+func TestNuGetDownloadUnparseableFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// A ".nupkg" request whose filename does not match the id/version path
+	// segments is a recognized-but-unparseable download and must fail closed
+	// rather than being forwarded uninspected.
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(nugetReq("/newtonsoft.json/13.0.1/mismatch.nupkg"))
+	assert.True(t, m.Matched)
+	assert.False(t, m.Pass, "an unparseable nupkg download must fail closed (Pass = false)")
+	assert.Equal(t, "nuget", m.Coordinate.Ecosystem)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Download, m.Operation)
+}
+
+type zipEntry struct{ name, body string }
+
+func nupkgZip(t *testing.T, entries ...zipEntry) []byte {
+	t.Helper()
+	var buf bytes.Buffer
+	zw := zip.NewWriter(&buf)
+	for _, e := range entries {
+		w, err := zw.Create(e.name)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		_, err = w.Write([]byte(e.body))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, zw.Close())
+	return buf.Bytes()
+}
+
+func nuspecXML(id, version string) string {
+	return `<?xml version="1.0"?><package><metadata><id>` + id + `</id><version>` + version + `</version></metadata></package>`
+}
+
+// nugetPush builds a push request with one multipart file part per entry of
+// parts, the shape dotnet nuget push sends.
+func nugetPush(t *testing.T, parts ...[]byte) (*http.Request, []byte) {
+	t.Helper()
+	var buf bytes.Buffer
+	mw := multipart.NewWriter(&buf)
+	for _, part := range parts {
+		fw, err := mw.CreateFormFile("package", "package.nupkg")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		_, err = fw.Write(part)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, mw.Close())
+	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, "https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package", bytes.NewReader(buf.Bytes()))
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", mw.FormDataContentType())
+	return req, buf.Bytes()
+}
+
+func TestNuGetMatchUpload(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	req, body := nugetPush(t, nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"Newtonsoft.Json.nuspec", nuspecXML("Newtonsoft.Json", "13.0.1")}))
+
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.True(t, m.Matched)
+	assert.True(t, m.Pass)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Upload, m.Operation)
+	assert.Equal(t, "Newtonsoft.Json", m.Coordinate.Name)
+	assert.Equal(t, "13.0.1", m.Coordinate.Version)
+
+	restored, err := io.ReadAll(req.Body)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, body, restored)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetUploadReadsPackagedNuspec(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// Packed .nupkg files put the nuspec after other entries, start it with a
+	// byte order mark and declare the nuspec XML namespace.
+	nuspec := "\ufeff" + `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>` +
+		`<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd"><metadata minClientVersion="2.12">` +
+		`<id>Newtonsoft.Json</id><version>13.0.1</version><authors>James Newton-King</authors></metadata></package>`
+	req, _ := nugetPush(t, nupkgZip(t,
+		zipEntry{"LICENSE.md", "MIT"},
+		zipEntry{"Newtonsoft.Json.nuspec", nuspec},
+		zipEntry{"lib/net6.0/Newtonsoft.Json.dll", "MZ"},
+	))
+
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.True(t, m.Pass)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: "Newtonsoft.Json", Version: "13.0.1"}, m.Coordinate)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetSymbolPackagePushIsChecked(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// A .snupkg pushed to the symbol endpoint carries a root nuspec too, so it
+	// is checked under the coordinate it names rather than blocked.
+	req, _ := nugetPush(t, nupkgZip(t,
+		zipEntry{"_rels/.rels", "<Relationships/>"},
+		zipEntry{"Serilog.nuspec", nuspecXML("Serilog", "3.1.1")},
+		zipEntry{"lib/net6.0/Serilog.pdb", "BSJB"},
+	))
+
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.True(t, m.Pass)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: "Serilog", Version: "3.1.1"}, m.Coordinate)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetUploadUsesOnlyRootNuspec(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// NuGet reads the single .nuspec at the archive root; a nuspec in a
+	// subfolder is package content and must not supply the coordinate.
+	req, _ := nugetPush(t, nupkgZip(t,
+		zipEntry{"content/decoy.nuspec", nuspecXML("Benign", "1.0.0")},
+		zipEntry{"Evil.NUSPEC", nuspecXML("Evil", "6.6.6")},
+	))
+
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.True(t, m.Pass)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: "Evil", Version: "6.6.6"}, m.Coordinate)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetUploadAmbiguousPackageFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// Each package names a coordinate NuGet would not use, or none at all.
+	repeated := `<package><metadata><id>Benign</id><id>Evil</id><version>1.0.0</version></metadata></package>`
+	cases := map[string][][]byte{
+		"two root nuspecs":  {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", nuspecXML("A", "1.0.0")}, zipEntry{"B.nuspec", nuspecXML("B", "2.0.0")})},
+		"only nested":       {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"content/A.nuspec", nuspecXML("A", "1.0.0")})},
+		"repeated id":       {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", repeated})},
+		"missing version":   {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", `<package><metadata><id>A</id></metadata></package>`})},
+		"oversized nuspec":  {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", nuspecXML("A", "1.0.0") + strings.Repeat(" ", maxNuspecSize)})},
+		"corrupt zip":       {[]byte("PK\x03\x04 not really a zip")},
+		"two packages":      {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", nuspecXML("A", "1.0.0")}), nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"B.nuspec", nuspecXML("B", "2.0.0")})},
+		"malformed nuspec":  {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", "<package><metadata><id>A"})},
+		"no nuspec entries": {nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"lib/a.dll", "MZ"})},
+	}
+	for name, parts := range cases {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+			req, _ := nugetPush(t, parts...)
+			m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+			assert.True(t, m.Matched)
+			assert.False(t, m.Pass, "an ambiguous or unreadable package must fail closed")
+			assert.Equal(t, "nuget", m.Coordinate.Ecosystem)
+			assert.Equal(t, policy.Upload, m.Operation)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNuGetUploadWithPrependedBytesIsChecked(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// Zip readers locate the archive from its end, so bytes in front of a
+	// package do not stop NuGet from reading it; they must not stop the
+	// matcher either.
+	pkg := append([]byte("prefix bytes "), nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", nuspecXML("A", "1.0.0")})...)
+	req, _ := nugetPush(t, pkg)
+
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.True(t, m.Pass)
+	assert.Equal(t, policy.Coordinate{Ecosystem: "nuget", Name: "A", Version: "1.0.0"}, m.Coordinate)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetNonPackageMultipartPutIsForwarded(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// Every PUT in the session reaches the matcher. A multipart upload with no
+	// package in it, such as a test report, is forwarded untouched.
+	req, body := nugetPush(t, []byte("<testsuite tests=\"1\"/>"))
+
+	m := NuGetMatcher{}.Match(req)
+	assert.False(t, m.Matched)
+
+	restored, err := io.ReadAll(req.Body)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, body, restored)
+}
+
+func TestNuGetUploadLargerThanWindowIsChecked(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	// The zip central directory sits at the end of the package, past the

+	pkg := nupkgZip(t, zipEntry{"A.nuspec", nuspecXML("A", "1.0.0")}, zipEntry{"lib/a.dll", strings.Repeat("x", 4096)})
